minerva_landlord.text: {greeting} The Minerva. They say it's the oldest pub in Plymouth, going back to about 1540. Low ceilings, thick walls, and a lot of ghosts who never paid their tab.
Drake drank round here, they say. Then again, they say that about every pub west of Bristol. He must have had a very busy liver.

minerva_quiz.text: Quiz night! Questions on the West Country, the Navy and whatever I read in the paper this morning. Fancy a round?
